summary: The retained r286 Chrome 153 full candidate uses the immutable lossless-exact-v4 browser reference, captures all 18 named states at both adopted viewports, passes all 36 accessibility captures and all four component journeys, and completes synthetic cleanup. V0R-MU-005 now renders the three unchecked todo controls with reference-shaped custom borders, vertically aligns them by todo index, horizontally aligns the indented third todo, and applies the retained reference-near toggle glyph placement. The four changed control regions reproduce an exact 423 pixel reduction, matching the full V0R-MU-005 reduction from r279. Unrelated repeat-run variability in V0R-MU-002 and one V0R-MU-014 pixel leaves the r286 full unmasked total 551 pixels above r279 and is not attributed to the source correction. Exact RGBA remains 0/36, so r286 is a mutable progress candidate only and is not immutable V0B evidence, a phase-gate claim, or a product-complete claim.
